text_description: Runway look centered on an off-white/cream textured tweed ensemble with a softly oversized, open-front jacket worn over a black, leather-like inner top. The jacket has a boxy, slightly relaxed silhouette with dropped-looking long sleeves, a broad collar/lapel area edged in black, black trim outlining the front opening and pocket areas, and small gold-tone buttons placed vertically along the front with matching buttons at flap-style chest and hip pockets. Underneath, the black top sits close to the torso and opens into a deep V neckline, with scarf-like black panels or lapels hanging down the front and fine pale piping/seam lines visible. The bottom is a matching high-waisted cream tweed straight skirt, fitted through the hips and falling to at least knee/midi length, with a prominent front slit slightly off-center that exposes the leg as the model walks. The palette is graphic and classic—cream, black, and gold—punctuated by long bright red drop earrings. The overall styling reads polished, structured, and couture-like, mixing nubby woven texture with smooth black shine and sharp contrast trim.

Underneath, the black top sits close to the torso and opens into a deep V neckline, with scarf-like black panels or lapels hanging down the front and fine pale piping/seam lines visible. The bottom is a matching high-waisted cream tweed straight skirt, fitted through the hips and falling to at least knee/midi length, with a prominent front slit slightly off-center that exposes the leg as the model walks. The palette is graphic and classic—cream, black, and gold—punctuated by long bright red drop earrings. The overall styling reads polished, structured, and couture-like, mixing nubby woven texture with smooth black shine and sharp contrast trim.
